description: Forwards a message with its original attachments. Optional comments go above the forwarded message via forwardText (plain) or htmlBody. Confirm with the user before sending.

attachments.description: Extra attachments in addition to the original ones (25MB total).

filename.description: File name shown to recipients, e.g. "invoice.pdf".

inline.description: If true, an inline image referenced from htmlBody as where N is its zero-based index in attachments.

mimeType.description: IANA MIME type. Defaults to application/octet-stream.

bcc.description: Bcc recipients. Plain email addresses (e.g. "user@example.com"); "Name <user@example.com>" also works.

cc.description: Cc recipients. Plain email addresses (e.g. "user@example.com"); "Name <user@example.com>" also works.

forwardText.description: Plain text comments above the forwarded message. No Markdown.

htmlBody.description: HTML comments above the forwarded message.

to.description: Primary recipients. Plain email addresses (e.g. "user@example.com"); "Name <user@example.com>" also works.

name: forward
